name: Push-ups
description: Classic bodyweight exercise for chest, shoulders, and triceps
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower your body until chest nearly touches the floor
Keep your body in a straight line
Push back up to starting position
breathing_instruction: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up
safety_notes: Stop if you feel shoulder pain

name: Wide Push-ups
safety_notes: Avoid if you have shoulder issues

name: Diamond Push-ups
description: Push-up variation targeting triceps and inner chest
instructions: Form a diamond shape with hands under chest
safety_notes: Easier on wrists than standard push-ups

name: Incline Push-ups
instructions: Place hands on elevated surface (wall, counter, or sturdy furniture)

name: Knee Push-ups
instructions: Walk hands forward into modified plank
form_cues: Maintain straight line from knees to head

name: Pike Push-ups
instructions: Bend elbows to lower head toward ground
form_cues: Head goes toward ground between hands

name: Superman
description: Lower back and posterior chain exercise
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead
Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off ground

name: Reverse Snow Angels
description: Upper back and rear shoulder exercise
instructions: Lie face down with arms at sides
Move arms in snow angel motion overhead
breathing_instruction: Exhale as arms move up, inhale as they return

name: Prone Y Raise
description: Upper back and shoulder stability exercise
instructions: Arms extended overhead in Y position
Lift arms and chest off ground
form_cues: Squeeze shoulder blades down and back

name: Prone W Raise
instructions: Arms bent at 90 degrees forming W shape
Lift elbows and chest off ground
breathing_instruction: Exhale on lift, inhale on lower
safety_notes: Improves posture and upper back strength

name: Swimmers
instructions: Lie face down in superman position
Alternate lifting opposite arm and leg

name: Shoulder Taps
instructions: Tap right hand to left shoulder

name: Plank to Downward Dog
instructions: Push hips up and back into downward dog
breathing_instruction: Exhale into downward dog, inhale to plank

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand with arms extended out to sides

name: Triceps Push-ups
instructions: Start in plank with hands directly under shoulders

name: Jump Squats
breathing_instruction: Exhale on jump, inhale on landing

name: Split Squats
instructions: Push through front heel to return
safety_notes: Great for leg balance and strength

name: Reverse Lunges
description: Lower body strength and balance exercise
instructions: Push through front heel to return
safety_notes: Easier on knees than forward lunges

name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Push through and lunge forward with left leg

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Slide down until thighs parallel to ground

name: Single-Leg Calf Raises
safety_notes: May need wall for balance initially

name: Squat Pulses
instructions: Pulse up and down in small range

name: Glute Bridges
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent
Lift hips until body forms straight line

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
instructions: Lie on back with one knee bent
Lift hips pushing through grounded foot

name: Frog Pumps
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent
Place soles of feet together, knees out

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back with arms extended up
form_cues: Keep lower back pressed to floor
breathing_instruction: Exhale as limbs extend, inhale returning

name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with hands behind head

name: Reverse Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent

name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on back with legs straight
safety_notes: Keep lower back pressed to floor

name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on back with legs extended
Alternate kicking legs up and down
safety_notes: Can be intense on hip flexors

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lift shoulders and legs off ground

name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet elevated

name: Heel Taps
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent

name: High Knees
form_cues: Knees to hip height or higher

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump feet apart while raising arms
Jump feet together while lowering arms

name: Inchworms
description: Full body mobility and strength exercise
instructions: Bend forward and walk hands out to plank

name: Squat to Knee Drive
instructions: Explode up driving one knee high

name: Plank Up-Downs
instructions: Press up to high plank one arm at a time
Return to forearms one arm at a time

name: Side Lunges
instructions: Bend stepping leg while keeping other straight

name: Sumo Squats
description: Wide stance squat targeting inner thighs
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders

name: Single-Leg Deadlifts
instructions: Extend free leg behind for balance
form_cues: Straight line from head to heel

name: Curtsy Lunges
instructions: Step one leg back and across behind other leg

name: Commandos
instructions: Push up to hand plank one arm at a time

name: Seal Jacks
instructions: Start with arms extended in front
Jump feet apart while opening arms wide
Jump feet together bringing arms back together

name: Broad Jumps
breathing_instruction: Exhale on jump, inhale on landing

name: Tuck Jumps
breathing_instruction: Exhale on jump, inhale on landing

name: Spider-Man Climbers
description: Dynamic core and hip mobility exercise
instructions: Bring knee to outside of same-side elbow
form_cues: Knee goes to outside of elbow
safety_notes: Great for obliques and hip mobility

name: Windshield Wipers
instructions: Lie on back with legs raised to 90 degrees

name: Wall Walks
instructions: Start in plank facing wall with feet against wall
form_cues: Stop before handstand if not ready

name: Dolphin Push-ups
instructions: Push hips up into dolphin pose

name: Scorpion Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with arms out
Tap foot to ground opposite side

name: Downward Dog
description: Full body stretch and shoulder exercise

name: Child Pose to Cobra
breathing_instruction: Inhale into cobra, exhale to child

name: Thread the Needle
instructions: Rest shoulder and head on ground
